statement: The record requests the "owner of the whole company's systems" access level for the contractor account ctr-migration@vendor.io.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the requested access level directly contradicts the stated rule that contractors never get company-wide ownership — "the record's access level is wrong" — flagging it as over-provisioned rather than merely asking to verify.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
